## Goal and expected behavior
The delivered shared-fragment feature requires complete citation paths, distinct revision identity and equivalent expanded/factored coverage:
https://github.com/unbraind/pm-context/blob/800b5af548ec1e7f765c4a441316c147eca2a8f7/.agents/pm/features/pm-context-shared-fragment-evidence.toon

Fixtures must initialize and mutate through the supported SDK clearing contract so these regressions actually reach their behavioral assertions on the upgraded SDK.

## Acceptance and limits
Migrate all affected fixture create/update/child-process calls to typed clearing semantics while preserving ambient-focus non-inheritance, all500 seeds, history/ABA/revision assertions, no-mutation checks and installed no-Git coverage. Restore full Node22/26 and packed gates at unchanged thresholds. Do not remove real SDK calls or replace them with mocks to make acceptance green.

This is a bounded fixture/upgrade acceptance defect, not evidence that production shared-evidence reads corrupt or mutate trackers. Exact immutable source and hosted logs were inspected; no local whole-suite rerun. All211 issue/PR bodies and101 current canonical records were checked; no existing owner for this SDK10.30 refusal was found. #197 is the separate resolved ENOTEMPTY cleanup failure.
